profile.headline: Software Engineer at Astea International (FieldCentrix)
profile.summary:
Experienced Application Developer, Database Administrator, and Project Manager in a wide variety of business applications. 

Particularly interested in client/server, web application and relational database design using MS-SQL Server.

Specialties: * Proficient in MS .net (C#, VB.net, ASP.net), VB6.0, Classic ASP (VBScript), Javascript, AJAX
* Confident in using php, css

* Proficient in using MS SQL-Server 2000, 2005, 2008 including query design & development, database tuning and administration
* Confident in using Oracle, My-SQL

* Proficient in managing Microsoft Windows 2008, 2003, 2000 Server, and Linux, Microsoft IIS, Linux APM

* Proficient in using Dreamweaver, Photoshop, Office, Visual Source Safe, SVN
* Confident in using Flash
